derivation: from (to heap up, i.e. accumulate or benefit);

occurrences.text: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.
What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
